error[L0301]: an `else` value stands in for this call's plain pointer, and does not widen it into `absent | denied | ptr mut u32`
  --> ../tests/fixtures/negative/pointer-union-many-call-else-atom-names-the-route/program.ldn:18:57
   |
18 |     present: maybe_cell = obtain(addr cell, false) else absent

  --> ../tests/fixtures/negative/pointer-union-many-call-else-atom-names-the-route/program.ldn:10:13
   |
10 |         -> (result: ptr mut u32 from cell) ! unavailable =
   |             ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ the successful call result
  = note: D235: recover into `absent | ptr mut u32` first, whose value widens into this union
